rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13964 §§1–4, 85 FR 81333–81335 (PDF pp.1–3). Section 2(a) directs standard branding rulemaking and subsequent implementation; §2(b) requires logo selection/display; §§2(c)–(d) impose ongoing marking and removal of inconsistent agency logos; §2(e) establishes written waivers and delegation limits; §3 requires an initial and annual implementation report. These recurring commands prevent treating the 30/120/180-day deadlines as whole-order expiration. EO 14029 §1, 86 FR 27025 (PDF p.1), expressly names and revokes EO 13964 as a whole. Section 2 separately directs consideration of rescinding implementing rules and abolition of entities; its qualifications attach to implementation, not the §1 revocation. EO 13964 §2(b)(ii) exempts administrative/nonproject materials and completed overseas projects, §2(e) allows aid-specific waivers, and §4 preserves statutory authority/appropriations. None saves a continuing original-command regime from whole-order revocation. Existing marked goods and surviving independently grounded agency rules are consequences, not proof that EO 13964 still commands. EO 14148 §2(gg), PDF p.2, revokes EO 14029. Full §§1–4 contain no affirmative re-enactment of EO 13964. Section 3(b), PDF p.5, orders review and appropriate future rescission/replacement/amendment of implementing actions; it does not itself restore this order.

source_reuse: Complete prior independent source readings reused only after maintained byte/span verification and source hash equality checks. Three newly supplied exact versions examined after the earlier seal; nine other accepted exact decision hashes remain unchanged.
source_evidence_limits: Underlying API/index/agency/court search records, evidence dossier contents and history-packet contents were not opened. Their supplied fingerprints are pinned, not independently reconstructed here. Status acceptance uses positive primary-source revocation and the complete supplied contrary text; it is not an exhaustive absence-of-restoration claim through cutoff.

Visual inspection covered EO10582 raw pp.1,3; EO14029 p.1; EO14003 p.1; EO14005 p.4; EO14122 p.1; EO14148 pp.2,5. Other modern pages were read as full extracted page text; full visual inspection of every page is not claimed.
